rust_summary: chunk light and resends for raw section writes (`native_relight_chunks`, `native_chunk_trackers`, `native_resend_chunk`).
doc_summary: `native_relight_chunks(dimension, chunks)` lights loaded chunks (and the loaded ring beside them) again at once, `native_chunk_trackers(dimension, chunk)` lists the players who have a chunk and `native_resend_chunk(dimension, chunk, player)` sends it again with its light to them or to one. Bundles need "hooks": @API:chunk_relight_resend@.
